items.title: Clyde Kerr Jr. interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 22, 2006
items.q: arrangement with the Chicago Jazz Ensemble with Jon Faddis. And they really loved it.

ctx.x: Oh yeah man. It’s just crazy. But my father did a lot with big bands and he loved Duke Ellington, Fletcher Henderson and the Jimmie Lunceford band and he taught himself how to write music and arrange for big bands and some of his music was at my sister’s home in a shed that was outside and I had about a third of that in my home but that part of my house was all wiped out by the storm. She lived by the London Avenue Canal and when that water came over it just knocked it out. Not only the music but tapes, photos…
arrangement with the Chicago Jazz Ensemble with Jon Faddis. And they really loved it. He did some beautiful music man. I was blessed.
Yeah. I have a little piece of music for you to listen to.
